name: telmoni
description: Skills for working with Telmoni: the SDKs that record the runs of the agents you build, the plugins that record your coding agent's own sessions, the telmoni CLI, API keys and the read-only /v1 API, signed webhooks, and self-hosting with Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

interface.longDescription: Works with Telmoni, the platform that records AI agents' runs as metadata, for organizations and projects, members and roles, API keys, notifications and a hash-chained audit log. Instruments the agents you build with the SDKs that record their runs, sets up the plugin that records a coding agent's own sessions, drives the telmoni CLI, calls the read-only /v1 API with an API key, builds and tests receivers for Telmoni's signed webhooks, self-hosts Telmoni with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, and finds answers at telmoni.com/docs. The skill itself sends nothing: it reads Telmoni's public documentation, and the telmoni commands it runs reach only the deployment the user names.
defaultPrompt: Add a route to my app that receives and verifies Telmoni webhooks.
Sign my CI pipeline in to Telmoni with an API key and check it works.
Help me self-host Telmoni with Docker Compose.
